[***Population and Development Review***]{.journal} · 2025

\[[Article](https://doi.org/10.1111/padr.70007)\] · \[[Code & data (OSF)](https://osf.io/q37es/)\] · \[[Media coverage](../media.qmd)\]

> *We compare the COVID-19 burden in 90 French regions with that of the 1911 and 2003 heatwaves and the Spanish and Hong Kong flu pandemics. The COVID-19 burden was, on average, 90% lower than the Spanish Flu and 75% lower than the 1911 heatwave, but four times higher than the 2003 heatwave.*
